items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: Unfortunately, my friend Mike Neal, the one that I spoke before, was living on Durban Street near the Maine. And when we were playing for Robe Show, we used to rehearse at his house.

ctx.x: Past the 28 years, 56 years. You didn't renew it, I guess.

No. I didn't renew it. I didn't renew it. It's in the public domain. Then I put music to another piece that Jean-Marie wrote. It was called Jailhouse Blues. And we found out that somebody else had a Jailhouse Blues. Yes. Bessie Smith made one of the record. Then we have- Then he wrote another one, Lloyd Babe. Lloyd Babe. And I put music to that. And there were several other pieces. There were orchestrated for it. And I got a- I got a- I got a- Chase them up there. I got a lot of music there. I got both classical…
You still play the Albert? Did you ever change over to the Bain system? No, no, no.
